Rules.InvariantScript:
// ❗ Dataverse: ClearCollect(gTaxis, PetraTaxis); ClearCollect(gTrips, PetraTrips)
Set(gLastRefresh, Text(Now(), "[$-de-DE]hh:mm:ss"))

// ❗ Dataverse: ClearCollect(gTaxis, PetraTaxis); ClearCollect(gTrips, PetraTrips)
Set(gLastRefresh, Text(Now(), "[$-de-DE]hh:mm:ss"))
"OFFENE AUFTRÄGE  (" & Text(CountRows(Filter(gTrips, Status = "pending" Or Status = "accepted" Or Status = "in_progress"))) & ")"
"👥  " & Text(ThisItem.Occupied) & " / " & Text(ThisItem.Capacity) & "  (" & If(ThisItem.Capacity - ThisItem.Occupied > 0, Text(ThisItem.Capacity - ThisItem.Occupied) & " frei", "voll") & ")"
If( ThisItem.Occupied >= ThisItem.Capacity, RGBA(220, 38, 38, 1), ThisItem.Occupied / Max(1, ThisItem.Capacity) >= 0.75, RGBA(234, 179, 8, 1), RGBA(34, 197, 94, 1))
Filter(gTrips, Status = "pending" Or Status = "accepted" Or Status = "in_progress")
ThisItem.PickupZone & If(IsBlank(ThisItem.PickupDetail) Or ThisItem.PickupDetail = "", "", " (" & ThisItem.PickupDetail & ")") & "  →  " & ThisItem.DropoffZone
"👥 " & Text(ThisItem.Passengers) & " Pax" & If(IsBlank(ThisItem.TaxiFunkID) Or ThisItem.TaxiFunkID = "", "", "  ·  🚕 " & ThisItem.TaxiFunkID) & If(ThisItem.OverflowWarning, "  ⚠ Überlast", "")
Sort(Filter(gTrips, Status = "completed" Or Status = "cancelled"), ID, SortOrder.Descending)
